name: Grand Tokyu Hotel
description: Hotel on Aba Road, Port Harcourt with five room categories, a courtyard pool, restaurant and bar, and an event hall for up to 200 guests.
priceNote: Published "book now from" starting rates per night; not live availability.
amenities: Event hall for up to 200 guests

faqs.q: Where exactly is Grand Tokyu Hotel?
faqs.a: At 273/274 Aba Road, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria — roughly five minutes from GRA Junction and ten minutes from Mile 1 Park. Port Harcourt International Airport is about 35 minutes away by taxi.

faqs.q: How much does a room cost?
faqs.a: Published “book now from” rates are ₦32,000 for a Standard Room (2 adults), ₦40,000 for a Classic Room (3 adults), ₦48,000 for a Standard Suite Room (4 adults), ₦68,000 for a Classic Suite Room (5 adults) and ₦240,000 for The Apartment (10 adults), per night. The Hall starts at ₦350,000. Rates change with season and availability.
Call the reservation desk on +234 091 6000 7896 or +234 091 6000 7897, message the hotel on WhatsApp, email grandtokyuhotel@gmail.com, or send a request from the booking page on this site.

faqs.q: How many people can each room sleep?
faqs.a: Standard Room 2 adults, Classic Room 3 adults, Standard Suite Room 4 adults, Classic Suite Room 5 adults and The Apartment 10 adults. The Hall holds up to 200 guests.

faqs.q: What time is check-in and check-out?
faqs.a: Check-in is generally from 12:00 and check-out by 11:00, but the hotel confirms the exact times with every reservation — please check when you book, especially for late arrivals.

faqs.q: Do you have a pool, a bar and a restaurant?
faqs.a: Yes. The hotel has an outdoor courtyard pool with a terrace and sun loungers, a bar and lounge, a rooftop bar, and a restaurant serving Nigerian and continental cooking, plus room service for house guests.

faqs.q: Is there parking and free Wi-Fi?
faqs.a: Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel and there is on-site parking for guests. Ask the front desk about airport pick-up and car hire when you book — availability is confirmed with your reservation.

faqs.q: Can you host my event or wedding?
faqs.a: The Hall takes up to 200 guests and comes with four standing air conditioners, free chairs and free Wi-Fi. The team arranges catering, layouts and AV — send your date and guest count through the events page. Smaller gatherings can use the restaurant, lounge or poolside terrace.

faqs.q: Are the rates on this site live?
faqs.a: No. They are the hotel’s published starting rates and are shown for guidance. Availability and final pricing are confirmed by the reservations team.
